blinding_guess.why: All ten ResourceManager methods are declared in the public header and defined in resource_manager.cpp with matching signatures. Minor inconsistencies only: the header parameter of command_interface_is_available is named 'interface' while its doc and the definition say 'name'; the header keeps an unused private claimed_command_interface_map_ while the implementation uses resource_storage_->claimed_command_interface_map_; get_controller_reference_interface_names reads the reference-interface map without a lock and make_controller_reference_interfaces_available reads it before locking; prepare/perform_command_mode_switch forward the full start/stop lists to every INACTIVE/ACTIVE actuator and system rather than only the interfaces each owns. None of these is clearly an interface defect from the code alone.
